reasons.supports: ドッキングステーションを残す（キネティック電源に反対）
reasons.summary_ja: ドッキングステーションは製品の売りになる
reasons.quote: I think our docking station could be one of the marketing issues with which we can um get great popularity for our product.

reasons.speaker: D

reasons.speaker: B
reasons.supports: 普通の電池一本で足りる（充電用ドックは不要）
reasons.summary_ja: 消費電力が少なく、電池一本で半年以上もつ
reasons.quote: it will run on one battery for um six months or f or or more. So I believe one battery uh is just enough.

reasons.speaker: D
reasons.supports: キネティック電源を採用しない
reasons.summary_ja: 高齢者は使う前にリモコンを振りたがらない
reasons.quote: Well personally I don't think that older people like to shake their remote control before they use it.

reasons.speaker: C
reasons.supports: キネティック電源も選択肢として検討する
reasons.summary_ja: キネティック電源は目新しいが、議論が必要
reasons.quote: Um well the kinetic energy source is rather fancy. But depends on what we want.

reasons.speaker: D
reasons.supports: 木目調と灰黒の二種類を出す
reasons.summary_ja: 高齢者は木の素材を好む
reasons.quote: our surveys have indicated that especially wood is pretty much the material for older people.

reasons.speaker: C
reasons.summary_ja: 木は価格を上げイメージにも合わない（二製品ラインなら別）
reasons.quote: people like wood, but it raises the price and it doesn't really fit the image, unless we would start two product lines.
